title: Covid-19 Saliva Sample Plating
author: Opentrons
materials: Sample is aspirated from tube A1
Sample is blown out of tip
Tip dropped, new tip achieved, repeat steps 1-4

steps.title: Aspirate sample from tube
steps.instruction: Using the P1000 single‑channel GEN2 pipette (mounted as specified), aspirate the Covid‑19 saliva sample from tube A1 at the defined aspiration speed, then wait the specified delay after aspiration.

substeps.instruction: Select pipette mount (left or right) as set in parameters.
Set aspiration speed (e.g., 1 × default or 0.5 × default).
Aspirate the sample from tube A1.
Pause for the defined number of seconds (Delay After Aspiration).

steps.title: Dispense into well and blow out
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated sample into well A1 of the 96‑well plate at the defined dispense speed, then perform a blow‑out to expel any residual liquid.

substeps.instruction: Set dispense speed (as defined in parameters).
Dispense the sample into well A1.
Blow out the tip to ensure complete transfer.

steps.title: Replace tip and repeat
steps.instruction: Eject the used tip, pick up a fresh tip, and repeat steps 1–2 for each remaining sample (up to the number of samples specified).

substeps.instruction: Proceed to the next source tube and corresponding well, repeating the aspiration, delay, dispense, and blow‑out sequence.
